title: Check a device-approval address
responsibility: Accepts a plain secure device-approval URL and rejects other addresses.

inputs.name: hostedAddress.value
inputs.description: The candidate URL, or undefined. It must use HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or IPv6 loopback, and have a /native/ path followed by one identifier of 1–128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

outputs.name: hostedAddress
outputs.description: The normalized URL when accepted, otherwise null. User information, query strings, fragments, other paths and invalid URLs are rejected. No request is sent.
